title: 12 Best Craft Beer in Mexico City
description: Discover the 12 best craft beer bars and breweries in Mexico City for 2026. From trendy Roma Norte brewpubs to hidden gems, find top-rated stouts, IPAs, and lagers. Explore local favorites, prices, and insider tips.

places.name: Falling Piano Brewing Co.
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any of their rotating IPAs or their 'Piano Bar Stout', paired with their artisanal pizzas.

places.name: Hop The Beer Experience 1
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask their staff for a flight recommendation based on your preferences; they always have interesting guest taps.

places.name: Principia Tasting Room
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try their 'Axiom' IPA or any of their seasonal sour beers; they are always pushing boundaries.

places.name: Crisanta Cervecería y Cocina
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Chapulin' Pale Ale (if available) with the Tacos de Carnitas.

places.name: Fiebre de Malta
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try their 'Cerveza de la Casa' (house beer) selection or a local Mexican Stout, paired with one of their gourmet burgers.

places.name: Taberna Calavera
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Mexican Imperial Stout' or seasonal fruit sours are highly recommended and often sell out quickly.

places.name: Monstruo de Agua (Roma Norte)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Pulque de Mango' sour or 'Cacao Imperial Stout' are innovative and delicious choices.

places.name: Yeccan Cervecería
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Maguey Pale Ale' for a uniquely Mexican twist, or a refreshing lager on a hot day.

places.name: Dr. Frankenstein
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask for their 'Pinta del Día' (pint of the day) or explore their tap list for a robust stout.

places.name: Dos Trece Cervecería
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Narvarte Pale Ale' or any of their seasonal IPAs, which are usually a highlight.

places.name: La Revoltosa Cervecería
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask the bartender for their latest tap from an emerging Mexican microbrewery; they excel at finding new talent.

places.name: Madrina Craft Beer Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Explore their varied bottle list, which often features unique and rare imports, or a premium Mexican IPA.
